answer_1.quote: We evaluate our models with word error rate (WER) and phoneme error rate (PER). For morphological inflection we use word-level accuracy (ACC) and character-level edit distance (LEV). For transliteration we compute word-level accuracy (ACC) and mean F-score (MFS). For dialect normalization we report BLEU.
datasets: Swiss German to German dialect normalization
answer_1.outputs: Generated phoneme sequences, inflected word forms, transliterated strings, and dialect-normalized sentences
